newsitem.title: INDIA: India villagers lynch three for black magic.
newsitem.headline: India villagers lynch three for black magic.

text.p: Three men accused of practising black magic were clubbed to death by angry villagers in India's southeastern state of Andhra Pradesh, police said on Wednesday.
They said the men were tied to pillars in the village community hall on Tuesday and attacked with sticks and knives. They were badly burnt by acid thrown on them.
Police were deployed to calm residents after the incident in Sutariguda village in the Rangareddy district, about 40 km (25 miles) from Hyderabad, the state's capital.
The three died in hospital, police said.

They said the attack was provoked by a villager's suspicions that the three had cast a spell on his family to cause the death of his wife and three buffaloes. The villagers held a council before the killing, the police said.
Police said they had arrested 13 people and were looking for others who had fled the village.
Accusations of black magic are common in the predominantly agricultural area, the police said. Voodoo objects are sometimes found in the homes of such victims, they added.
